taskTitle: Where ten HTTP header fields are defined

checks.detail: 3 proposers ran in parallel, one per lens
4 phases had the tools designed for them

finalText:
All ten fields are defined in current RFCs:
- Age, Cache-Control, Expires: RFC 9111 (HTTP Caching), sections 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3. It obsoletes RFC 7234, which therefore does not count.
- Last-Modified, ETag, Location, Retry-After, Vary: RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics), sections 8.8.2, 8.8.3, 10.2.2, 10.2.3 and 12.5.5. It replaces RFC 7231 and RFC 7232.
- Strict-Transport-Security: RFC 6797, section 6.1. The page header shows no obsoleting RFC.
- Link: RFC 8288, section 3. The page header says "Obsoletes: 5988", the older Link RFC, and shows no obsoleting RFC.

I could not open the rfc-editor.org/info pages (404). "Not obsoleted" therefore rests on the document headers and text, not on the RFC Editor's status index.

Sources opened:
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6797.html
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288.html
